profiles.bio: Retro gaming enthusiast and high-score chaser.
Building next-generation HTML5 multiplayer arcade experiences in India.

games.title: Neon Cyber Runner 2088
games.shortDescription: Dash, jump, and dodge laser barriers in this synthwave endless runner.
games.fullDescription: Sprint across neo-Tokyo rooftops while evading rogue security drones. Time your high jumps and slide under magnetic beams to rack up the ultimate high score in full retro-futuristic audio.
games.controlsGuide:
Space / Up Arrow: Jump (Double tap for double jump)
Down Arrow: Slide
P: Pause Game

games.title: Cyber Blood Carnage
games.shortDescription: 16+ Brutal retro cyber arcade shooter with relentless enemy swarms and heavy synth metal.
games.fullDescription: Survive in an apocalyptic cyberpunk arena against cybernetic horde invaders with plasma shotguns and chainblades.
games.controlsGuide:
WASD: Move
Left Click: Rapid Fire
Space: Dash

games.title: Sky Glider Academy
games.shortDescription: Wholesome cartoon flight action navigating colorful cloud rings and floating islands.
games.fullDescription: Soar through bright skies, collect golden stars, and perform loop-de-loops in this cheerful family-friendly aerial action adventure.
games.controlsGuide:
Arrow Keys: Steer Glider
Space: Speed Boost

games.title: Shadow Strike: Spec Ops
games.shortDescription: High-octane tactical combat shooter and reflex-heavy infiltration.
games.fullDescription: Take down rogue cyber mercenaries with sniper rifles, explosive breach charges, and close-quarters combat.
games.controlsGuide:
WASD: Move
Mouse Left Click: Shoot
R: Reload

games.title: Cosmic Gem Matcher
games.shortDescription: Relaxing jewel matching puzzle with soothing ambient soundtrack and 100+ stages.
games.fullDescription: Swap constellations and match crystal prisms in this calming, family-friendly brain puzzle.
games.controlsGuide: Mouse / Touch: Drag and swap gems

games.title: Dark Asylum: Escape Room
games.shortDescription: 16+ Gripping psychological horror mystery with cryptic puzzles and macabre secrets.
games.fullDescription: Solve bone-chilling cryptographic riddles and navigate eerie corridors before time runs out in this dark thriller.
games.controlsGuide: Mouse: Inspect objects and combine clues

games.title: Voxel Dungeons
games.shortDescription: Procedural voxel dungeon crawler with loot and monsters.
games.fullDescription: Explore subterranean mazes, collect magic weapons, and defeat skeleton kings in real-time isometric perspective.
games.controlsGuide:
WASD: Move
Left Click: Attack
I: Inventory

games.title: Demon Soul: Dark Reckoning
games.shortDescription: 16+ Brutal dark-fantasy action RPG with challenging boss encounters, parrying, and dark sorcery.
games.fullDescription: Venture into the cursed abyss to vanquish towering demonic overlords with grim swordsmanship and blood magic.
games.controlsGuide:
WASD: Move
Space: Roll/Dodge
Left Click: Heavy Strike
Q: Spell

games.title: Cyber Blade Odyssey
games.fullDescription: Hand-crafted pixel art adventure with custom orchestral music.

games.title: Neural Maze Escape
games.fullDescription: AI-generated labyrinths synthesized by deep neural networks.

games.title: Hybrid Star Fighter
games.shortDescription: AI concept art refined with human mechanics.
games.fullDescription: Fast-paced space arcade fighter with human-coded gameplay and AI concepts.

Incredible cyberpunk arcade mechanics! Smooth 60fps controls and great soundtrack.
